# clavis connections

<p class="cli-lead">Manage org-wide provider credentials that syncs share</p>

<div class="cli-usage">

```sh
clavis connections <command>
```

</div>

A connection stores one provider credential for the whole organization:
a Forgejo or GitHub token, AWS keys, a service account. Syncs created
with `--connection` reuse it, so you paste a token once and rotating it
updates every sync that uses it. Credentials are never shown again.

<a class="cli-card" href="./connections-test"><span class="cli-card-name"><code>clavis connections test</code></span><span class="cli-card-text">Check that a connection works for the syncs that use it</span></a>
</div>

## Examples

```sh
clavis connections create "Home Forgejo" --provider forgejo --url https://git.example.com --token -
```
